title: Neo4j connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Neo4j instance's settings, read by the native protocols family (`loams_connector_protocols::neo4j`, CN2 Task 21) over Neo4j's HTTP Query API (5.19 or later; no Bolt, D634 (c)). `auth.*` hold secret **names** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`.

auth.description: HTTP Basic or a bearer token (SSO), by secret name.

basic.description: HTTP Basic: the user name and the password's secret name.

password.description: The password. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

bearer.description: A bearer token (SSO). The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

sink.description: A parameterised statement per batch, the batch's event data bound as `$rows`.

statement.description: The statement; it must use `$rows` (`UNWIND $rows AS row MERGE …`).

delete_statement.description: Run for events with loamsop = d; it must use `$rows`.

source.description: One split per label, read in `(cursor, elementId)` order.

label.description: The label read; also the split id and the events' resource.

cursor.description: The property the source orders and resumes by.

statement.description: A custom statement taking `$cursor`, `$after` and `$limit` and returning `cursor` and `eid`, ordered by them.

poll_interval_ms.description: Keep polling from the cursor at this interval; one pass without it.
